scenes.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: landscape inline story painting for the graded-reader “The Earth That Stays Put”
Primary request: depict the end of paragraph 1: Chie and her mother set off in their lunar rover before the long night, and Chie looks back to see the blue Earth above the base.
Input images: Image 1 is the approved inline style reference only; Image 2 guides Chie's character identity and palette only.
Scene/backdrop: quiet grey lunar hills around a small base and a few simple solar panels beneath a deep black sky; the blue Earth hangs above the base.
Subject: a compact practical rover travels away from the Moon base. Chie, a twelve-year-old girl with dark hair tied back, wears the simple blue-grey uniform from the cover and turns to look back through the rover's open side. Her mother drives. Keep both calm and readable, with no helmet indoors.
Style/medium: gentle children's picture-book painting in the approved Kasa Jizō inline treatment: broad smooth colour areas, gentle contours, minimal texture, a few purposeful folds and shadows, quiet simplified background; distinctly simpler than the textured cover.
Composition/framing: medium-wide landscape about 12:7; rover and two people in the foreground, base and blue Earth clear but secondary in the distance; two or three broad depth layers.
Lighting/mood: cool late-afternoon light before lunar night, thoughtful and calm.
Color palette: warm ivory, midnight indigo, muted teal, soft grey, with the Earth as a restrained blue accent.
Constraints: portray only the departure and Chie's backward glance from paragraph 1. Do not hint that anyone will become lost. No lettering, signs, labels, title, border, frame, or watermark.
Avoid: stranded rover, blank screen, lost characters, radio distress, rescue, photorealism, glossy 3D, dense brush texture, busy background.
